svg.aria-label: Secure AWS CI/CD overview. In your repo and CI, every commit to the Git repository is scanned by gitleaks, which fails on a leak, before it reaches the pipeline, CodeBuild or GitHub Actions. The pipeline assumes an IAM role or uses OIDC and gets temporary credentials back, reads secrets at build time from Parameter Store or Secrets Manager, and deploys through Systems Manager, which runs the command on an EC2 instance with port 22 closed. Before, the pipeline file held an AWS access key, a DB password, an SSH key, and a server IP.
svg.title: Secure AWS CI/CD: a pipeline with no stored keys, passwords, or SSH
svg.text: No keys, passwords, or SSH in the pipeline
